title: Paydown Addition to Settlement Installments: Deficiency Balance Accounts Training Note
content:
**Rule.** The settlement paydown share of an account held under Deficiency Balance Accounts is the total amount of the account's posted payments and applied credits, less the total amount of its returned payments, divided by the original deficiency. A settlement paydown share of 0.3 (30 percent) or more adds 2 installments to an installment settlement, one of at least 0.15 (15 percent) but below 0.3 adds 1 installment, and a smaller one adds none.

## Ladder

| Settlement paydown share | Installments added |
|---|---|
| 0.3 or more | 2 |
| 0.15 up to but not including 0.3 | 1 |
| Below 0.15 | None |

## Questions answered

**Over what period are payments counted?** All posted payments and applied credits since opening, less every returned payment.

**What is the share divided by?** The original deficiency on the opening date.

## Worked shares (hypothetical; original deficiency $4,000.00)

| Paid down | Share | Installments added |
|---|---|---|
| $1,200.00 | 0.30 | 2 |
| $1,190.00 | 0.2975 | 1 |
| $600.00 | 0.15 | 1 |
| $590.00 | 0.1475 | None |
